recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future edits to questionnaire-itemControl should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than reintroducing the extension definition to core.
issue_request: FHIR-31347 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Questionnaire and requested explanatory guidance for why questionnaire-itemControl.value[x] is CodeableConcept, including that CodeableConcept.text alone should not be used because the extension is intended for computable rendering guidance.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 22d02daa69f8e296b9316b6978fdfc47f3f04c6e added requirements text to source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-itemControl.xml explaining that CodeableConcept allows additional codings for finer-grained or environment-specific controls and warning against text-only values.
additional_context: The current FHIR core checkout no longer contains an active questionnaire-itemControl extension source definition; source/fhir.ini has no itemControl entry, source/questionnaire has no itemControl definition file, and dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed questionnaire extension definitions from R5 core source. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-questionnaire-itemControl.xml with the requested requirements text intact.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The relevant artifact is outside the current FHIR core checkout and the maintained Extension Pack definition already satisfies the issue.

related_jiras.note: A later historical commit touched the same item-control extension guidance, but it did not alter the FHIR-31347 CodeableConcept requirements text and was not independently reconciled here.

evidence_items.summary: Lloyd McKenzie answered that CodeableConcept permits additional code translations and agreed that text is not useful.
